QuestInfo.name: Leaving the Pond
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Ask the Elder for advice.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to reach the pinnacle of strength, find the Forest of the Priest in Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Harmonia, the Warrior Priest, in the Forest of the Priest.

0.0: I must admit, #h0#, you know how to fight. But you're starting to remind me of a big fish in a small pond. If you want to leave that pond, go to Leafre, village of the Halflingers, and find the Forest of the Priest.\r\n\r\n#r(If you accept, you'll travel there automatically.)

yes.0: The Forest of the Priest is home to true masters of strength. Your new teacher will be waiting for you there.

no.0: Not interested in getting stronger? Sure, just walk away.

1.0: Welcome, seeker of strength. I am Harmonia, the Warrior Priestess.

npc.0: To Leafre with you! Even greater power awaits!
